brief: Prioritize a payment using its stated consequence and deadline, rather than labeling an object as always necessary or always optional.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Protect what matters now"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Protege lo necesario hoy"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Proteja o necessário agora"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Prioritize a payment using its stated consequence and deadline, rather than labeling an object as always necessary or always optional.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: When money is limited, ask what happens if a payment waits. The answer depends on the person and the situation.
instruction.misconception: Treating needs and wants as permanent labels on objects or judging another person spending without context.
instruction.numeracy_support: Amounts are not needed; compare explicit consequences and deadlines.

evidence.reasoning: A phone can be essential for receiving work calls. Replacing a working phone just for a new color can wait.
Ask: what stops working if I delay this? Protect a stated essential use before an upgrade with no urgent purpose.
Transport protects the stated work trip; the case can wait.
The same object can serve different needs.
The upgrade has no urgent function in the stated situation.
The consequence is missing; the label alone cannot set the priority.
The stated damage explains the priority without judging decoration.
Replacing broken work equipment protects the stated activity.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Apply this skill in a later integrated decision with a different constraint.

en-US.line: When money is limited, ask what happens if a payment waits. The answer depends on the person and the situation.

pt-BR.line: Quando o dinheiro é limitado, pergunte o que acontece se um pagamento esperar. A resposta depende da pessoa e da situação.

en-US.line: A phone can be essential for receiving work calls. Replacing a working phone just for a new color can wait.

es-MX.line: Un teléfono puede ser necesario para recibir llamadas de trabajo. Cambiar uno que funciona solo por otro color puede esperar.

pt-BR.line: Um telefone pode ser necessário para receber chamadas de trabalho. Trocar um que funciona só por outra cor pode esperar.

en-US.line: Ask: what stops working if I delay this? Protect a stated essential use before an upgrade with no urgent purpose.

pt-BR.line: Pergunte: o que deixa de funcionar se eu adiar? Proteja um uso necessário antes de uma melhoria sem urgência.

en-US.prompt: Which payment protects the stated need?
en-US.scene: Ana needs transport to work tomorrow. A new phone case is optional.
help: Look at the consequence of delaying each payment.

feedback.met: Transport protects the stated work trip; the case can wait.
feedback.not_yet: Look at the consequence of delaying each payment.

feedback.not_yet: Mira la consecuencia de aplazar cada pago.

feedback.not_yet: Veja a consequência de adiar cada pagamento.
